person.name: Adel Ghasempour
person.role: Game designer · Mobile puzzle and hybrid-casual
person.bio: Game designer for mobile puzzle and hybrid-casual games who finds the real reason behind player behavior, then proves every fix with data. At Voodoo: +12% retention from a dynamic difficulty system and a CPI cut from $8.50 to $0.95. Founder of MahfeleBazi, a game design academy. 8 puzzle games designed and released.

projects.title: Moonlight Chess

gallery.alt: Moonlight Chess board and match screenshot

projects.description: A puzzle game that takes chess somewhere new, blending traditional strategy with new mechanics for depth and replayability. I designed its 75 hand-made levels and their difficulty curve.
projects.role: Game design, level design and programming

projects.title: Free Arrow
projects.description: A minimalist arrow puzzle: clear the board by sliding arrows out in the right order, with limited lives per level. Its procedural generator outputs only valid, solvable levels, and a bit-packed save system fits 100,000 levels in 2 MB.

projects.title: Try Harder
projects.description: A personal project built from the initial idea through design, coding, 30 hand-made levels, character creation and sound effects. Designed to challenge even dedicated players.
projects.role: Solo developer: design, programming, art and sound

projects.title: Oldman Bubbly
projects.description: A heartfelt point-and-click adventure made during a game jam. I developed the game and mentored three new teammates as players solve puzzles to help an elderly man recover treasured memories.

projects.title: Monster Jam
projects.description: A puzzle-hybrid casual game inspired by color-matching mechanics: match monsters with doors of the same color. Playtesting helped refine the core puzzle and its feel.

projects.title: Sweet Dreams
projects.description: A surreal survival game shifting between nightmares and happy dreams. Fight living toys with a flashlight, build confidence, then turn the tables and chase them. Created with two 3D artists and a sound designer; awarded second place at the Snappy Gurus Game Jam.
projects.featuredNote: Second place at Snappy Gurus Game Jam

projects.description: A game design case study of how Railbound's first tutorial level teaches its interaction language through constrained puzzles, visual demonstration, partial guidance and consistent directional cues.

experience.title: Game Designer / Prototype Developer
details: +12% retention, longer sessions: designed and built a dynamic difficulty system for LiveOps. The lift averaged 12% across D1 to D30, highest at D1.
CPI cut from $8.50 to $0.95: used A/B tests and GameAnalytics campaign data to find the visual changes that drove the drop.
Selected for Voodoo's publishing program: passed a portfolio review, then created multiple hybrid-casual prototypes and ran them through Voodoo's market tests.

experience.title: Founder and Game Design Instructor
details: About 120 attendees per event: a workshop every 3 months and 1 to 2 game jams a year. 5 events so far.
35-person board game workshop and jam: teach game design hands-on through workshops and jams.

experience.title: Game Designer, Developer and Team Lead
details: 4 games shipped: sole designer and programmer, leading a 4-person team (2 artists, 1 sound designer).
2,000+ downloads of game assets released on marketplaces.

experience.title: Freelance and Contract Developer
details: 10+ client projects: delivered games and AAA Unreal Marketplace assets.
